title: Image deletion policy conflict
purpose: Document two unresolved deletion requests for an uploaded image after its owner selects Delete.

scope.text: immediate permanent deletion of an uploaded image when its owner selects Delete
the same deleted image remain recoverable by its owner for 30 days after Delete

requirements.text: immediate permanent deletion of an uploaded image when its owner selects Delete
the same deleted image remain recoverable by its owner for 30 days after Delete

stories.text: If a human selects the immediate permanent deletion policy, an image owner can delete an uploaded image permanently.
acceptance_criteria: Given a human has selected the immediate permanent deletion policy, when the owner selects Delete on an uploaded image, then the image is permanently deleted immediately.

stories.text: If a human selects the 30-day recoverable deletion policy, an image owner can recover a deleted image within 30 days after Delete.
acceptance_criteria: Given a human has selected the 30-day recoverable deletion policy, when the owner selects Delete on an uploaded image, then that same deleted image remains recoverable by the owner for 30 days after Delete.

dependencies.text: No stakeholder has authority to choose between these requests yet.
A human must select one of the two deletion policies as authoritative before an implementation can satisfy both requests without violating the other.

risks.text: Immediate permanent deletion would fail the 30-day recoverability request; 30-day recoverability would fail the immediate permanent deletion request.

success_metrics.text: If a human selects immediate deletion, verification can observe that a deleted image is not recoverable immediately after Delete.
If a human selects 30-day recoverability, verification can observe that a deleted image remains recoverable by its owner within 30 days after Delete.

open_questions: Which deletion policy should a human select: immediate permanent deletion or 30-day recoverability after Delete?
Who has authority to select the policy?
What happens after the 30-day recovery period under the recoverability alternative?
